command:
echo "=== Extracting questions/recommendations/items from V1 docs ===" && for f in /home/newadmin/swarm-bot/master/POPW/working/code/industreal_improved/code/industreal_improved/analyses/consult_claude_science/[0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.md; do
  name=$(basename "$f" .md | sed 's/^[0-9]*_//')
  echo "--- $name ---"
  grep -E "^- \*\*(Tier|Question|Q[0-9]|Tier [0-9]|Phase|Day [0-9]+|Item [0-9]+|[0-9]\.|Action|Decision)" "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -10
done 2>&1 | head -100
